description: Get accepted delivery for one immutable job with caller-supplied x402 authorization. Use this when an agent holds fresh PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms and the caller approves the spend; the caller supplies payment_response as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value and SML never signs or spends. Returns the Evidence Pack plus the PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt; on missing authorization returns a fresh 402 challenge, on a bad job_id a structured error. With valid caller authorization, settles an irreversible USDC payment and persists a receipt; the stored job remains immutable. For example, accepting a quoted job delivers the full Evidence Pack with settlement proof.

payment_response.description: The caller x402 payment authorization payload for this exact job, supplied as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this job.

name: aftersearch_accept

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.
